result.topic_en: Relations between geodetic latitude φ and reduced latitude ψ on the spheroid, followed by an alternative step-by-step solution of a geodesic problem (computing latitude, azimuth and longitude difference from a given arc and azimuth), with an approximate series correction.
result.transcription:
Man bemerke noch die Relationen
$\tang\psi = \sqrt{(1-ee)}.\tang\varphi$
$\cos\psi = \frac{\cos\varphi}{\sqrt{(1-ee\sin\varphi^2)}}$
$\sin\psi = \sqrt{\frac{1-ee}{1-ee\sin\varphi^2}}.\sin\varphi$
$\partial\psi = \partial\varphi.\frac{\cos\psi.\sin\psi}{\cos\varphi.\sin\varphi} = \partial\varphi.\frac{\sqrt{(1-ee)}}{1-ee\sin\varphi^2}$
Obiges Problem kann auch so aufgelöset werden
band IX p. 122
1) $tg\psi = \sqrt{(1-ee)}.tg\varphi$
2) $tg u = tg.S.\cos\zeta$
3) $tg L = \frac{\sin u \tang\zeta}{\cos(\psi-u)} \doteq \frac{\tang S.\sin p}{\cos(\psi-u)}$
4) $tg\psi' = tg(\psi-u).\cos L$
5) $tg\varphi' = \frac{\tang\psi'}{\sqrt{(1-ee)}}$
6) $tg p = tg.\zeta.\cos S$
7) $tg q = [-\tang\psi-]{+(\psi-u)+}.\sin\zeta.\sin S = \tang L.\sin\psi'$
8) $q-p = \zeta'$
9) $\lambda = L\sqrt{\frac{1-ee}{1-ee\sin\varphi^2}}$
Setzt man
$\tang(\psi-u) = \sqrt{(1-ee)}.tg(\varphi-w)$ so ist hinlänglich genau
$w = (4) As.\cos\zeta$ $\quad \log 4 = \frac{1}{3}.\frac{ss}{aa}.\frac{1-ee\sin\varphi^2}{1-ee} - \frac{1}{3}ww.\frac{(1-ee\sin\varphi^2)^2}{1-ee}$
$= \mu - \nu$
$p = \zeta - \frac{1}{2}(5).\frac{1-ee\sin\varphi^2}{1-ee}.\frac{ss}{aa}.\cos\zeta\sin\zeta$ $\quad \log 5 = \frac{1}{2}\mu - \frac{3}{4}\nu$

methods.what: Reduced (parametric) latitude in terms of geodetic latitude
Cosine and sine of reduced latitude in terms of geodetic latitude
Differential relation between reduced and geodetic latitude
Nine-step algorithm for the direct geodesic problem via auxiliary sphere (reduced latitude, auxiliary angle u, longitude L, new latitude, azimuths p,q, longitude λ)
Final azimuth from difference of auxiliary angles and longitude scaling
Approximate correction w and series for logarithmic coefficients
Series approximation for the azimuth p
